title: Chicken à la King
description: A classic Continental chicken dish featuring tender poached chicken, mushrooms, and bell peppers in a rich velouté cream sauce, traditionally served over puff pastry, rice pilaf, or fresh egg noodles.

ingredients.title: For the Chicken & Stock
items: Alternatively, use 500 g cooked roast chicken, cubed, and 1 L good-quality chicken stock.

ingredients.title: For the Sauté & Sauce
items: Green bell pepper – 1 small, finely diced
Dry sherry or white wine – 60 ml (¼ cup) (optional but traditional)

instruction.title: Step 1 – Poach the Chicken
steps: In a saucepan, combine chicken, carrot, onion, celery, bay leaf, thyme, peppercorns, and water.
Bring to a gentle simmer (do not boil).
Poach for 12–15 minutes, until chicken is just cooked through.
Remove chicken and strain the stock.
Reserve the stock and dice the chicken into ¾-inch (2 cm) cubes.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Prepare the Sauté Base
steps: Heat butter and olive oil over medium heat.
Add onion and green pepper; sweat until translucent (about 3 minutes).
Add mushrooms and cook until softened and lightly browned.
Stir in flour and cook for 1–2 minutes to form a light roux.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Make the Velouté Cream Sauce
steps: Gradually whisk in chicken stock until smooth and slightly thickened.
Stir in cream, sherry, and Dijon mustard.
Simmer gently for 5 minutes until the sauce coats the back of a spoon.
Adjust seasoning with salt, white pepper, and lemon juice.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Finish the Dish
steps: Add diced chicken to the sauce and simmer gently for 2–3 minutes.
Stir in chopped parsley just before serving.
The texture should be velvety and rich, not too thick—like a light cream stew.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Professional Presentation
steps: Serve over buttered puff pastry shells (Vol-au-Vent style) for the classic presentation.
Alternatively, serve on a bed of buttered rice pilaf.
Or serve with fresh tagliatelle or egg noodles for a bistro-style presentation.

instruction.title: Step 6 – Garnish
steps: Garnish with chiffonade of parsley.
Add fine julienne of red pepper (blanched for color contrast).
Finish with a drizzle of cream or truffle oil (optional for haute cuisine plating).

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve over buttered puff pastry shells (Vol-au-Vent style).
Serve on a bed of buttered rice pilaf.
Serve with fresh tagliatelle or egg noodles.

chefTips: Stock Quality: A clear, aromatic chicken stock defines the depth of flavor. Avoid using cubes for restaurant-standard results.
Mushroom Technique: Sauté until moisture evaporates before adding flour—this prevents a floury taste.
Sherry/Wine: Dry sherry (Fino or Amontillado) adds authentic Continental richness and aroma.
Consistency: Sauce should nappe the spoon—glossy, smooth, and flowing.
